name: menu-to-gameplay
demonstrates: Tapping PLAY on the menu enters .gameplay and shows the generated neon city - the streamed isometric ground lattice with whole-building sprites standing on it, plus the player actor - with no placeholder text painted over it. Rooftop signs are deliberately not promised here: RooftopSignPlacement signs roughly one block in three, so whether one is in frame is a property of the fixed GameScene.worldSeed and camera position rather than something this journey guarantees. The gate on this journey is human/vision review of the gameplay-city screenshot; the only machine-checked steps are assert_running, and the placeholder-label removal itself is pinned by ScreensTests.test_gameplayScreenNode_mountsNoComingSoonText and ScreensTests.test_gameplayScreenNode_mountsOnlyTheContainerMarker_andNoTextAnywhere, not by this journey. The element-driven PLAY tap that AccessibleSKView exists to protect stays owned by CyberpunkMonsterCrawlUITests.test_launchesIntoMenu_withAHittablePlayButton_thatStartsARun; the visual navigate step below is additional coverage, not a replacement for it.

steps.target: the large neon-outlined PLAY button in the middle of the title screen that starts a new run (NOT the plain HIGH SCORES button below it)
